checks.detail: Runtime slice passes: both bound receipts show fresh build, WebDriver session, window title, auth-shell render, product-UI separation pass, embedded assets, status=pass with zero errors; the two 1280x800 screenshots show a clean auth shell consistent with PRD 9.1 auth properties (calm editorial canvas, restrained accent, sign-in primary, no prohibited patterns). Static review supports security (capabilities/main.json least-privilege core:event:default only; CSP default-src 'self'; anti-enumeration auth) and interface scope (27 IPC commands, 22 data-testid hooks, Focus/Calendar/Settings implemented, reminder dedup/cancel/retry schema). But runtime evidence covers ONLY the anonymous shell: no signed-in, persistence, reminder-delivery, or recovery receipts; zero live captures exist for any section 9.1/9.2 state beyond the sign-in card; both receipts report golden_path.state=unavailable. Against PRD sections 8/9/11, implementation review cannot pass when the observed surface is one of nine required surfaces.

Neither required layer is verified. Black-box: the host replay drove only an invalid-email validation on the anonymous auth shell (one validation delta; both screenshots show only the sign-in card), and both receipts record golden_path.state=unavailable because the renderer provides no #golden-path-probe element for the replay's 60s DOM wait, so PRD section 3 steps 2-11 were never observed live. White-box: the registered focusboard-verify exporter is still import-hijacked (this loop's --doctor probe returned the focusboard-native-webdriver doctor payload instead of focusboard-verify's own), so no white_box+black_box receipt exists and the SQLite migration/recovery/idempotency validation required by the tauri engine guidance could not run. A Rust self-drive test covering steps 1-11 exists at lib.rs:649, but its passing execution is a developer claim, not independent evidence.

developer_outcome.summary: Risk-note validation is the live host replay; focusboard-native-webdriver is not callable from this role. Mitigations are candidate-bound: hooks on every step, deterministic near-term reminder firing with dedupe, restart-durable focus sessions (white-box proven), clean Xvfb smoke launch. Host replay should now reach each state and recapture receipts; report any undrivable step as blocked.
